title: ES cross-market breakout confirmation gates NQ noise-VWAP entries
baseline: faithful core.engine, run on common NQ-intersect-ES date set
es_state_source: ES own bars / ES own cumulative RTH VWAP / ES own 90-session noise bands via core.data.load_rth + noise_bands

variants.agree: PRIMARY: take NQ signal only if ES broke out the same way (es_break == want)
variants.gate: take NQ signal only if ES in any breakout (es_break != 0)
variants.vwap: take NQ signal only if ES on same side of its own VWAP (es_vwap == want)
variants.es_dir: enter NQ in ES breakout direction (want = es_break)
variants.es_opp: enter NQ opposite ES breakout (mirror-trap check, Rule 16)
variants.disagree: take NQ signal only if ES disagrees (GC weak-survivor control)

primary_metric: net daily Sharpe uplift of agree over common-set baseline
rarity_discriminator: gross-per-trade on KEPT trades vs baseline; re-pairing null CENTER

null.pairing: each NQ session <- random OTHER ES date state series, same tods
